title: MCP：一次拒绝带多条原因时，把 details.refusals 逐条转给智能体（接 #36877）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding N2 of the seat's contract-tier L2 on PR #37395 (#36877), comment 7181155005; the seat asked the owning zone to file a carrier under the parent. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (with the parent) · reach: every action or hook refusal with several reasons reached through MCP, once #36877 ships · evidence: L2 N2; `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` ~L1368–1379 relays `userMessage` and, for FLOW_FAILED only, a relay sentence built from `details`.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#36877 让服务端一次拒绝可以带多条已翻译原因，放在 `details.refusals`。MCP 现在只转 `userMessage`（/data 上会截到 500 字），多条原因可能被截掉。改成把每条原因完整转给智能体。
- 谁受益：通过 MCP 操作的智能体和它背后的用户，能看到每一条被拒的原因。
- 不做会怎样：原因多时，智能体只看到被截断的一段，结尾那句可能丢。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- When a coded refusal carries `details.refusals: [{ reason, message }]` (shape defined by #36877), the MCP tool result names every refusal line whole, in order, with the entry's closing line last, instead of relying on the (possibly 500-char-cut) `userMessage`.
- Follow the existing FLOW_FAILED pattern (`flowFailureRelaySentence`): read the details as the spec declares them, imported, never hand-spelled. Keep the #7450 withholding rule for `PermissionDeniedError` details.

## Acceptance

- A refusal with several reasons reaches an MCP caller with every line whole; a single-reason refusal reads as today.
- Pins for both, plus one where `userMessage` was cut at 500.

## Order

After the #36877 server PR (#37395) merges; it defines the wire shape.

Blocked-by: #36877

Reader: zone o5-U files it; area:ai zone picks it up.
Dedupe: open issues for "details.refusals" and "MCP refusal reasons" return none besides #36877/#37403.
